description: Measure a page against the design system in a real browser and return every violation with the fix. Pass html for a draft, or url for something already served. This is the loop: draft, lint, apply the fixes, lint again.

html.description: A complete HTML document to measure.

register.description: Which register the page is in, if the document does not declare it.

url.description: A file:// or https:// page to measure instead.

viewports.description: Widths to measure. Defaults to the system's four plus two sampled from between them.

name: standards_lint
